items.title_en: HUST BCIML EEG Decoding Benchmark and Paper-to-Code Gallery
bullets_zh: 华中科技大学BCIML于2026年9月12日在GitHub发布统一EEG解码基准与可检索论文代码库。
它汇总非侵入式BCI解码方法并提供可复现代码链接。
适合研究者比较EEG模型并查找实现。
bullets_en: HUST BCIML released a unified EEG-decoding benchmark and searchable paper-to-code gallery on GitHub (Sep 12, 2026).
It aggregates non-invasive BCI decoding methods with reproducible code links.
Useful for researchers comparing EEG models and finding implementations.

bullets_zh: MOABB 1.7.1在NEMAR下载边界捕获泄漏的httpx.TransportError异常。
当通过代理或HTTP传输失败无法访问NEMAR时，它保持本地缓存的上游数据集数据可用。
bullets_en: MOABB 1.7.1 catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at NEMAR download boundaries.
It keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or HTTP transport failure.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.1修复NEMAR网络错误下缓存数据可用性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.1 fixes NEMAR transport errors to keep cached EEG benchmark data usable.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).

bullets_zh: MOABB 1.7.0让BaseDataset.get_data在NEMAR预取前使用完整处理缓存，在网络或NEMAR不可用时保持离线访问。
它还为dataset_bubble_plot提供可复现布局，使基准可视化更稳定。
bullets_en: MOABB 1.7.0 makes BaseDataset.get_data use a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, preserving offline access when network or NEMAR is unavailable.
It also gives dataset_bubble_plot reproducible layouts for more stable benchmark visualizations.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.0改善离线缓存与气泡图可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.0 improves offline cached-data access and reproducible dataset bubble plots.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible. - `BaseDataset.get_data` now uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, so cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable. - `dataset_bubble_plot` now has reproducible layouts by default and accepts `random_state` for controlled alternatives. Full changelog: https://moabb.

It avoids prefetching when cached data is already available.
It preserves NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal, improving benchmark reproducibility and efficiency.

bullets_zh: NeuroTechX MOABB于2026-08-27合并AcquisitionMetadata.n_channels元数据修复。
它从channel_types推导n_channels，而非单独存储。
这解决了147个目录数据集中34个的不一致，提升基准元数据可靠性。
bullets_en: NeuroTechX MOABB merged a metadata fix on 2026-08-27 for AcquisitionMetadata.n_channels.
It derives n_channels from channel_types instead of storing it separately.
This resolves disagreements found in 34 of 147 catalogued datasets, improving benchmark metadata reliability.
items.brief: MOABB修复通道数元数据不一致，提升EEG数据集目录准确性。
items.brief_en: MOABB derives n_channels from channel_types, fixing inconsistent EEG dataset metadata in the catalog.
items.raw_excerpt: Derive AcquisitionMetadata.n_channels from channel_types instead of storing it (#1166) AcquisitionMetadata stored n_channels next to channel_types, which describes the same fact.
